full_wall_summary.exclusions: Only named print-object Outer/Inner/Overhang walls; supports, prime tower, infill, travels and custom moves excluded by feature annotations.
full_wall_summary.method: Continuous-polyline Hausdorff enclosure; 0.001mm residual. Width compatibility is spatial, not just a min/max check. No entire G-code file is loaded.

parallel_execution.memory_scope: At most eight submitted layer pairs; six worker-local GEOS geometries and sample chunks. No entire G-code or mesh is loaded.

full_distribution.method: Bidirectional per-filament nearest-wall distances with all wall classes combined; length-weighted midpoint samples. Sampling does not certify exact extrema or entire paths.

parallel_execution.memory_scope: At most eight submitted layer pairs; six worker-local GEOS geometries and sample chunks. No entire G-code or mesh is loaded.

complete_wall_interpretation.scope: All named-model wall layers from both completed Normal Lift G-code files, with unchanged strict 0.02mm displacement and width thresholds.
limitations: Feature-separated outer/overhang differences can reflect slicer feature relabeling; they are not direct physical displacement measurements.
Combined-wall comparisons retain filament identity while allowing wall-feature labels to change.
Length-weighted distribution is sampled at <=0.01mm spacing and does not certify every point or exact extrema.
Nominal deposited-footprint diagnostics are recorded separately and do not override the strict wall gate.

examples.observation: The largest measured sample lies on a reference inner-wall corner omitted from the candidate path. Candidate sparse infill does not recover this local tip; the external silhouette is not displaced by the full inner-wall error.

The candidate inner-wall corner extends farther, while reference solid infill already covers the sampled point. Including all model deposition substantially reduces the discrepancy; this is partly wall/infill substitution.
The largest local difference is a shortened sharp inner-wall corner. Some nearby infill changes, but the reference samplepoint remains uncovered by candidate nominal model deposition.

interpretation_limits: The top-three centerline extrema are inner-wall corners, not removal of an entire molecular branch or a global external-silhouette shift.
Nominal WIDTH/2 buffers approximate deposited material; no physical bead-shape, strength or successful-print claim is made.
The exact internal slicer decision causing each corner change was not isolated.
Feature-separated outer/overhang maxima can be dominated by relabeling. For example at Z57.84 the outer-class upper bound is5.776mm while the same-tool combined-wall bound is0.086413mm.
Exact-fallback source slabs show only very localized near-threshold wall differences, sampled maximum0.020558mm; their mechanism was not isolated.
Spatial width-compatibility failures can arise from displaced paths even when emitted width values are unchanged.

final_ranked_footprint_diagnostics.method: Worst three length-sampled centerline locations. Re-read one source/candidate layer at a time; buffers use each emitted WIDTH/2 with round caps/joins. Continuous Hausdorff enclosure is measured between nominal deposited-area sets, not only their boundaries. Visible-wall diagnostic combines outer and overhang classes to avoid class relabeling false positives.
limitations: Nominal footprints approximate deposited material; they do not certify physical extrusion shape or print strength.
Whole-layer footprint distance is per selected filament; local colored areas use the shown crop.
Worst sampled centerline positions need not coincide with worst footprint difference.
Local all-model coverage includes other filaments and infill; this separates material coverage from wall-class labels but does not validate color placement or overall print strength.
